page.layout: Top: running head "PARS SECVNDA." with page number 237 at right. Below: two round portrait medallions side by side, each with an inscription around its rim (left: BOR. / CAROL. DVX.; right: LEVA. / ANTONIVS DE). Below them: one text column in two paragraphs. At the foot: a decorative ornament, no text.

main_text.l: BOR. CAROL. DUX.
LEVA. ANTONIUS DE
CAROLUS Borbonij Dux, Comitis Gilberti à Monte-
pēserio filius,Janam Ducatus Borbonij hęredem unicam,duxit
uxorem:hunc Gilbertum præfectum Neapoli reliquit Carolus
octauus.Porrò Carolus eius filius Magister equitum , seu Con-
nestabilis , à Francisco Valesio creatus est anno à Christo nato
1516. Fuit quidem princeps hic magnanimus ac bellicosus , sed
qui ob factionem quandam ad Imperatorem deficiens,cladem
patriænon minimam attulit:tandémque in expugnatione Ro-
mæ occisus est. Nam ipsi stanti in scalis , globusænej[?] tormenti
parum caute à suis emissus(ut est plena periculi eiu,[?] generis ar-
morum tractatio)crus alterum sub femore perfregit, quo ex vul-
nere post unum atque alterum diem , animam exhalauit. Vide
Chron. Regum Franc. & re. memor.Paral.
ANTONIUS Leva,Mediolano primùm,deinde expedi-
ti-oni Cæsarianæ præfectus , cùm paralysi laboraret, in cathedra
sedens circumferebatur:industrius quidē ille , ac in rebus belli-
cis arte Pelasga, quasi alter Sinon instructissimus. Moritur præ
dolore uani ac casi in Massiliam conatus:cùm eius spe potiun-
de , à Melforum Principe ad eam recipiendā ex Italia pruden-
ter ac callidè euocatus esset:nempe ea arte ut in Taurinũ susce-
ptam ab ipso expeditionem auerteret,anno à Christo Seruato-
re nato 1535.

page.notes: Medallion inscriptions are transcribed as they stand around each rim; the ordering around the circle is reconstructed. Doubtful readings marked [?]: "globusænej" (the final letters of the ænej group are unclear) and "eiu," (the final letter is uncertain). The ç/ć forms in "prꝫfećtum"/"oćtauus" were read as præfectum and octauus, which is my interpretation of the glyphs. The ornament at the foot has no text.
